SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, vendored for local Excel import.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs
Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

This file contains library code only. No guest data is bundled. The app loads this local copy only when an Excel file is imported.
